newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: GK Goh increases Straits Assets stake.
newsitem.headline: GK Goh increases Straits Assets stake.

text.p: G K Goh Holdings said on Wednesday it would raise its stake in Malaysia's Straits Assets Holdings Bhd (SAH) to 37 percent of the enlarged share capital.

Singapore stockbroking company G K Goh said in a statement it had agreed conditionally with certain Straits Assets shareholders to buy approximately 3.17 million shares, or 7.04 percent, for a total consideration of 19.7 million ringgit. Under the terms of the agreement, financial concern Rashid Hussain Bhd, GK Goh's co-shareholder in SAH, would purchase 5.38 million shares from the vendors representing approximately 11.96 percent. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
